record.reason: PreQuant quantizes pre-trained language models before fine-tuning and evaluates task performance under lower precision. Its goal is task-agnostic model quantization, but the evaluated workflow centers on fine-tuning and does not establish a deployed inference-speed benefit; retain as a weak quantization lineage connection.
record.title: PreQuant: A Task-agnostic Quantization Approach for Pre-trained Language Models
